description:
Open the partially-scaffolded customer journey map at ~/Diagrams/return_journey.drawio and populate all 25 content cells (5 stages × 5 rows) with the specific touchpoints, customer actions, emotional states, pain points, and opportunities described in ~/Desktop/return_journey_spec.txt. The specification file contains journey data based on published Baymard Institute and Narvar e-commerce return research.

The starting file already contains the title, 5 stage column headers (Discover Return Policy, Initiate Return, Prepare & Ship, Await Processing, Receive Resolution), and 5 row labels (Customer Actions, Touchpoints/Channels, Emotional State, Pain Points, Opportunities). All 25 content grid cells are empty and need to be filled.

Requirements:
1. Add text content for each of the 25 cells as specified in the spec file
2. Color-code the Emotional State row: green (#d5e8d4) for positive, yellow (#fff2cc) for neutral, red (#f8cecc) for negative/frustrated
3. Add at least 5 dependency arrows connecting related Pain Points to their corresponding Opportunities (as listed in the spec)
4. Save the diagram
5. Export the completed map as PNG to ~/Diagrams/exports/return_journey.png
